replies.author: Polar_Express
replies.body: Evocal, please explain why you think having a lot of diamonds would make for bad game play? We can have a map full of iron where everyone has full iron and game-play is fine, what is the difference if everyone can have the same level of gear? other than people will live and fight longer and have fun longer and wont be two hit?  I really think having the perception that "Diamonds" make for poor game-play does not have any supporting information backing it other than " this is what I think". As for the center, I can change it, but i'm not going to change it unless I know this is a map you are going to be accept with all the diamonds as I am not taking the Diamonds out. Think about this - Why is it more fair and game play better on maps where only some people can get diamonds and other do not? Why is it more fair for a few people to dominate a map because they know where the diamonds are? Please explain your game play comment. I made the map so that Avicus could have something different, it is not a map people are going to see and leave like 2-3 we currently have in rotation. It is more balanced than most maps we have, and it will be a lot of fun. Again,  please reply as I would like to understand the information you have about game-play that apparently I do not , on the diamond subject, amount of diamonds per player that are allowed, Amount of diamonds that make for a great map, number of players that are allowed diamonds, and most of all why unlimited iron is fine but unlimited diamonds are not when the balance is 100% on all sides? I have played more walls maps than anyone on the server pretty much, so I would just like to know. Thanks so much for taking the time to answer my questions. Again, You may not agree with the "looks" of the center, and I will change it, but please do respond about the rest of the map and game-play.

replies.author: keenanjt
replies.body: Here's my two cents. I wouldn't want to play on this map where I spend a mere minute mining enough diamond for myself and then waiting the remaining 9-14 minutes only to find that everyone is in the same exact position as me. The Walls is about taking the preparation time to create your own style of gameplay, whether it be through preparing an elaborate base with traps, digging deep into the caverns to mine and find the best armor or perhaps utilizing your kit to it's maximum ability to eliminate your enemies. Giving diamonds to all (most?) players in a match of The Walls effectively forces all users into a similar style of gameplay. Sure that may seem balanced, but part of what makes The Walls fun is that you must make an effort to better yourself in a match.

replies.author: Polar_Express
replies.body:
Good to see you Ivy -

Your view is only one view  of how the walls should be played, it is not definitive . First the match is 10 minutes long, no way you have 9-14 min to  wait.  The diamond vein is 45 blocks high off the ground and you start with no blocks or tools. "you still have to get wood and iron, smelt the iron and craft" How long does all of that take? next even if you build directly up ( after getting wood / stone /pick / iron smelt) to the diamonds after making your tools and getting wood etc, your at what at the 3-4 min mark? min. Next getting diamonds is not the only point of the map, you have to enchant, find the enchant table ( or kit your own ), and actually dig many more diamonds for exp to enchant. Now, at this point you have diamond armor and a sword, you don't have any potions, apples, limited food, or special items. So that is where the 30+ chests and the hidden areas come into play..... The thing about the diamond vein is that its built to give walls players a faster paced game after spending hours digging in a mine... The map looks cool, and plays well ( yes I have played it ).

You speak like similar style is a problem... Really, every map on the walls is played the exact same way, so the game style argument is not valid in the least. The guy that knows the best loot path wins, period. What is fun for new or learning players when they never have a chance? Or Nebula or nexus players that want a little lower pace without having to learn where all the diamonds / loot is... Even  On great maps like village, the guy that knows where 26 diamonds are is one of the last people standing each map, it never changes.  On walls or jungle, full enchanted Iron, and your one of the last standing. On the Diamond Vein, get full enchanted diamond you got a shot no matter what anyone else has - to me that sound like fun. I had time to prepare, I had time to organize with my team members, now we can all go out stacked. The map will also encourage more team work than some other maps. Not a problem in my book....but hey Ivy its your server....

 Lastly - back to the Diamond Vein, you still have to "better" yourself in the match, your not going to get full diamond without enchants and have the same chance? That's like iron vs diamond, you just have to have the vision to play at a different level. Getting diamonds is the start of the match not the end and the map has plenty of chest to run around and find - download it and walk around in it - see where the chest are and how it would play....

 Granted after all this talk the map will not be added to Avicus, that's not the reason I am still debating this issue. The reason is Avicus has so may walls maps that play the same - its wash rinse and repeat. I am so tired of seeing new players stop playing walls because they never can find enough stuff, or have to skybase to have a chance. Why not add some walls game-play that is more interesting and mixes it up once in a while. All of my maps add a different " out of the box" play-style, that still have the feel of walls , but with a kick. Lastly no admin can comment on how the map will play , as its not in rotation on the server.

After all it is a map, if it were to be added it would be one map in rotation, and not a walls changing event, lol -  but it would be fresh and different and may draw a few players looking for something in the middle of the " Walls game-play" and the Nexus/Nebula Game-play. Dont we want to attract more players?
